messages:
Alex: quick sync — I'm trying to formalize precedence when we have segmented captures (e.g. /org/:orgId/*) vs header-anchored routes (x-service: accounts). noticed a couple of prod hits where a generic capture swallowed a header-anchored route.
Priya: ugh, saw that too. consequence was users routed to legacy accounts svc instead of accounts-v2.
Jorge: can you paste the two matching routes? makes it easier to reason about specificity.
Alex: sure:
```
- route A: host=*.redwood.ai, path=/org/:orgId/* -> svc: payments
- route B: host=accounts.redwood.ai, path=/org/:orgId/profile -> svc: accounts-v2, headers: {x-service: accounts} 
```
Nora: so route B is more specific by host and path literal, but route A had a header policy missing so the matcher picked A due to earlier evaluation order.
Priya: that's the thing — our current tiebreaker is "first-match after score" which leaves order-dependent surprises. we should prefer deterministic scoring that weights anchors.
Jorge: proposal: introduce a degree-of-specificity score composed of: host-specificity (wildcard penalty), path-segment specificity (literal>param>wildcard), header-anchor count (each anchor +10), explicit service tag (+5). sum and pick max.
Alex: I like numeric scores. example on those two: B would get host-specificity + path literals + header-anchor = wins.
Nora: edge: what about param captures versus header anchors? header anchors should beat a param capture with same host/path weight.
Priya: agreed. make header-anchor weight high enough to override a single path literal? maybe +20 per header? might be too strong.
Jorge: let's simulate with a few real patterns and traffic distribution. I'll run a matcher-sim job against the last 7 days of routing logs.
deploy-bot: matcher-sim job queued (job id: sim-3812). ETA ~12m.
Alex: also UX question — should console show the computed score in explainability UI? would help debugging.
Priya: yes please. show breakdown: host score, path score, header score, total. small help tooltip explaining weights.
Nora: and rollout: we should gate by config flag per-cluster and ship as opt-in, then flipped after 2 weeks of no regressions.
Alex: action items: (1) Jorge run sim and post summary in this thread, (2) Priya draft console explainer with mockups, (3) Nora add opt-in flag + tests. I'll follow up with RFC PR.
Jorge: on it. sim job started, will post csv.
Priya: mockup pushed to figma -> link: https://redwood.design/figma/matcher-weights (internal).
Nora: creating feature flag: matcher_new_scoring. adding unit tests for ambiguous cases.
Alex: thanks — rough consensus? thumbs? :thumbsup:
Priya: :thumbsup:
Jorge: :thumbsup:
Nora: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: matcher-sim job completed (sim-3812). results: 124 ambiguous hits reduced to 3. CSV attached to job artifact.
Alex: perfect — Jorge, can you attach the CSV here and open the RFC PR once you have sims?
Jorge: CSV uploaded to artifacts (artifact://sim-3812/summary.csv). opening RFC in a bit.
